content_sections.heading: About IIM Ranchi
content_sections.text: IIM Ranchi describes itself as an autonomous institution founded by the Ministry of Education, Government of India, in December 2009. It currently offers a two-year MBA, MBA-HRM and MBA-BA, a full-time Ph.D., an Executive Ph.D. (ePh.D.) and an Executive Post Graduate Programme in Management (Executive MBA).

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The minimum qualification for all four posts is a Ph.D. or equivalent degree. Candidates are required to have a good publication record in ABDC/ABS journals. Candidates must have made the final submission of their Ph.D. thesis for external review as on the last date of application. For designation-wise shortlisting criteria for experience, the notice refers to the Ministry of Human Resources Development circular F.No.23-1/2008-TS.II dated August 18, 2009, September 16, 2009 and September 22, 2009. The research/teaching/industry experience is expected to be in a relevant area. All qualifications must be from a UGC recognized University/Deemed university or an AICTE approved autonomous institution (wherever applicable); courses from autonomous institutions should be equivalent to the relevant course approved/recognized by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU). Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.post: Assistant Professor Grade-II (Assistant Professor on contract)

rows.experience: Total experience of 3 years in research/teaching/industry
Experience of 6 years, of which at least 3 years should be at the level of Assistant Professor at equivalent peer institutions
Experience of 10 years, of which at least 4 years should be at the level of Associate Professor at IIMs/IITs/IISc/NITIE/IISERs/other equivalent peer institutions

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The notice gives these as the details of pay and the total minimum emoluments admissible at the time of joining. In addition, benefits such as LTC, medical re-imbursement, contribution towards EPF/NPS, faculty development allowance and financial support towards national and international conferences shall be permitted as per Institute norms. Faculty members are permitted to pursue industry consultation with income sharing as per the Institute rules. There is a provision for additional compensation for teaching/training, subject to fulfilling the minimum work-norm of the Institute. Depending on the academic credentials of the candidate, the Institute may consider them for an offer on a contractual basis of one/two/three year(s). Relaxation in qualification and experience, or a higher start in the time scale, may be considered for exceptionally bright candidates.

content_sections.heading: IIM Ranchi Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice gives one set of expectations for all the faculty posts. Selected candidates are expected to: Teach across various programmes. Publish high-quality research papers in leading academic journals. Contribute to academic administration from time to time as per the norms set by the Institute. Engage in institution development. Conduct training programmes. Engage in consultancy work. Candidates should have a strong academic background and an understanding of current developments in their field of expertise.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIM Ranchi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to https://iimranchi.ac.in/careers/ and fill the online application form, using Advt. no. ADVT/IIMR/IPC-FR/ALL/2026/NOV. The notice says the application must be made in the appropriate format available online at https://www.iimranchi.ac.in/careers . Submit the online application on or before 5:00 PM on 2 December 2026. Persons already working in Central/State Government/Public Sector Undertakings/Autonomous organizations should send their applications through proper channel. For technical problems in filling up the form, or any query about it, email the IT Office at [email protected] with a copy to the IPC Office at [email protected] , or call 9547512477. The notice does not mention an application fee.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: The notice names these documents, to be produced at the seminar/interview stage: Caste/category certificate in the prescribed format for central government employment, for reservation under the Government of India rules. For NC-OBC and EWS, a certificate valid for the current financial year. A No Objection Certificate from the current employer, for candidates already working in Central/State Government, Public Sector Undertakings or autonomous organizations.

faq.question: Q1. Which posts are advertised in IIM Ranchi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: IIM Ranchi has advertised Assistant Professor Grade-II, Assistant Professor Grade-I, Associate Professor and Professor posts in Information Systems & Business Analytics and Legal Studies & Responsible Business (Business Law).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIM Ranchi faculty posts?
faq.answer: The online application must be submitted on or before 5:00 PM on 2 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for IIM Ranchi faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: A Ph.D. or equivalent degree is required, with a good publication record in ABDC/ABS journals. The final Ph.D. thesis must have been submitted for external review as on the last date of application.

faq.question: Q4. How much experience is needed for each post?
faq.answer: Assistant Professor Grade-II needs no prior experience. Grade-I needs 3 years in research/teaching/industry. Associate Professor needs 6 years, with at least 3 at Assistant Professor level. Professor needs 10 years, with at least 4 at Associate Professor level.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for IIM Ranchi faculty posts?
faq.answer: Professor Rs. 1,59,100 – 2,20,200; Associate Professor Rs. 1,39,600 – 2,11,300; Assistant Professor (Grade I) Rs. 1,01,500 – 1,67,400; Assistant Professor (Grade II) Rs. 70,900 (minimum basic), under the 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for IIM Ranchi faculty recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Go to https://iimranchi.ac.in/careers/ and fill the online application form with Advt. no. ADVT/IIMR/IPC-FR/ALL/2026/NOV before the deadline.

faq.question: Q7. Does IIM Ranchi offer other benefits besides pay?
faq.answer: Yes. LTC, medical re-imbursement, contribution towards EPF/NPS, faculty development allowance and conference support shall be permitted as per Institute norms. Additional compensation for teaching/training is subject to the Institute's minimum work-norm.

faq.question: Q8. Is the IIM Ranchi faculty job permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The posts are advertised through regular recruitment, but the Institute may consider a contractual offer of one/two/three year(s) depending on academic credentials. Grade-II is listed as Assistant Professor on contract.

faq.question: Q9. Do government employees need permission to apply?
faq.answer: Persons already working in Central/State Government, PSUs or autonomous organizations should apply through proper channel. If called for seminar/interview, they must furnish a No Objection Certificate from their current employer.
